subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped set of 13 new third-party action revisions across secret-bearing, publishing, security-scanning, repository-automation, and Codex workflows?
rationale: The pin-only patch appears technically correct, but repository policy assigns acceptance of new executable supply-chain code at privileged boundaries to human owners.

options.title: Approve grouped refresh
options.body: Accept the exact revisions together after current-head checks finish and security plus CI/release owners verify the upstream changes.

options.title: Split sensitive families
options.body: Separate token, Docker publishing, CodeQL, and Codex updates when their owners need independent review or proof.

options.title: Hold existing pins
options.body: Defer the refresh if any upstream revision or representative workflow cannot be verified safely.

recommendation.title: Approve grouped refresh
recommendation.body: Accept the exact revisions together after current-head checks finish and security plus CI/release owners verify the upstream changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The security ownership policy covers the highest-risk changed workflows, making the security area the best available decision owner for accepting the grouped supply-chain boundary.
